### 2. Electron + React Architecture

**Three-process model:**

**Main Process** (`src/main/index.ts`):
- Creates a `BrowserWindow` (1400x900, min 1024x700) with `contextIsolation: true` and `nodeIntegration: false`
- On `app.whenReady()`: calls `initDatabase()`, loads catalogue seed data, auto-generates catalogue collections, registers IPC handlers, then creates the window
- In dev mode loads from `ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL`; in production loads `../renderer/index.html`
- Standard macOS `activate` re-creation and `window-all-closed` quit logic

**Preload** (`src/preload/index.ts`):
- Minimal bridge: exposes a single `window.api.invoke(channel, ...args)` function via `contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld`
- This is the only communication pathway between renderer and main

**Renderer** (`src/renderer/`):
- React 18 SPA using `HashRouter` from react-router-dom v7
- Root render in `main.tsx` using `createRoot` with `StrictMode`
- All data access goes through `window.api.invoke()` via the `useIPC` hook or the `invoke` helper

**IPC Pattern:**
- The renderer calls `window.api.invoke(channel, args)` which maps to `ipcRenderer.invoke(channel, args)` in preload
- The main process registers handlers via `ipcMain.handle(channel, handler)` in `src/main/ipc/handlers.ts`
- Each channel has a corresponding Zod schema in `src/main/ipc/schemas.ts` that validates the incoming payload before it reaches business logic
- The `validated()` helper wraps every handler with `schema.parse(rawArgs)`, rejecting malformed data with Zod errors
- There are **30+ IPC channels** organized by domain: `targets:*`, `sessions:*`, `collections:*`, `workflow:*`, `equipment:*`, `folders:*`, `observatory:*`, `planning:*`, `dashboard:*`, `relationships:*`

---

### 3. Database Patterns

**Database Technology:**
- `better-sqlite3` for synchronous SQLite access
- `drizzle-orm` for schema definition and type safety (though services use raw SQL via `sqlite.prepare()` rather than the Drizzle query builder)
- Database stored at `app.getPath('userData')/astrorepo.db`
- WAL journal mode enabled for concurrent read performance
- Foreign keys enforced (`PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`)

**Schema (14 tables)** defined in `src/main/db/schema.ts`:

| Table | Purpose | Key Columns |
|---|---|---|
| `targets` | Central target registry | id (ULID PK), canonical_name (unique), object_type, ra_hours, dec_degrees, magnitude, angular_size_arcmin, constellation, workflow_stage, is_custom |
| `target_aliases` | Alternate names for targets | target_id (FK), alias (unique), source |
| `catalogues` | Catalogue definitions | name (unique), abbreviation (unique), total_objects, is_builtin |
| `catalogue_entries` | Target-to-catalogue mapping | catalogue_id (FK), target_id (FK), designation; unique on (catalogue_id, designation) and (catalogue_id, target_id) |
| `collections` | Target collections | name (unique), is_auto, source_catalogue_id (FK) |
| `collection_memberships` | Many-to-many collection-target | composite PK (collection_id, target_id) |
| `observation_sessions` | Observation log entries | date, observatory_id (FK), sky_quality, weather, seeing, transparency, moon_phase, exposure stats |
| `session_targets` | Session-to-target mapping | composite PK (session_id, target_id), is_primary |
| `equipment` | Equipment inventory | name, equipment_type, manufacturer, model, serial_number, is_active |
| `session_equipment` | Session-to-equipment mapping | composite PK (session_id, equipment_id), role |
| `observatories` | Observation locations | name (unique), latitude, longitude, altitude_m, timezone, is_primary |
| `workflow_stages` | Lifecycle stage definitions | name (unique), sort_order, is_default; 12 default stages seeded |
| `workflow_transitions` | Stage change audit log | target_id (FK), from_stage, to_stage, transitioned_at |
| `target_relationships` | Inter-target spatial/semantic links | source_target_id, related_target_id (both FK), relationship_type; unique constraint + self-reference CHECK |
| `folder_templates` | Directory structure templates | name, structure (JSON), is_builtin; Siril default seeded |
| `app_settings` | Key-value application config | key (PK), value |

**FTS5 Full-Text Search** (`src/main/db/fts.ts`):
- Virtual table `targets_fts` indexes `canonical_name`, `aliases` (group_concat of target_aliases), `description`, `constellation`
- Maintained via 5 triggers: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on targets, plus INSERT/DELETE on target_aliases
- `rebuildFtsIndex()` does a full reindex
- Search uses FTS5 MATCH with prefix matching (`"term"*`), falling back to LIKE on `canonical_name`/`alias` if FTS returns no results

**Indexes:** 12 indexes defined covering all major query patterns (alias lookup, canonical name, object type, workflow stage, designations, sessions by date, etc.)

**Migration approach:** Inline SQL in `runMigrations()` using `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` and `INSERT OR IGNORE` -- no formal migration versioning system

**ID generation:** All entities use ULIDs (`ulid` library) for sortable, unique identifiers

**Seed data:** Three JSON catalogue files (`messier.json` with 110 objects, `caldwell.json`, `sharpless.json`) loaded on first run with cross-catalogue identity resolution via alias matching

---

### 4. UI Component Patterns

**Styling:**
- **Tailwind CSS** with a custom dark-theme `astro` color palette defined in `tailwind.config.js`:
  - `astro-bg: #0f1729` (deep navy background)
  - `astro-surface: #1a2332` (card/surface background)
  - `astro-border: #2a3a4e` (borders)
  - `astro-accent: #4f9cf7` (interactive accent blue)
  - `astro-text: #e2e8f0` (primary text)
  - `astro-muted: #94a3b8` (secondary text)
  - `astro-success/warning/danger` for status colors
- Custom scrollbar styling via `::-webkit-scrollbar` in `global.css`
- No component library (Radix, shadcn/ui, etc.) -- all components are hand-built with Tailwind

**Layout architecture:**
- `Layout` -- flex container: `Sidebar` (fixed 224px width) + scrollable `main` area
- `PageContainer` -- page-level wrapper providing title, optional subtitle, optional action buttons, and max-width content area
- `Sidebar` -- 9 navigation items using `NavLink` with active state highlighting (accent color border + tinted background)

**Reusable components:**
- `SearchBar` -- debounced (300ms) text input with clear button
- `TargetCard` -- card component with object-type-specific color coding (11 type-to-color mappings), aliases display, constellation, magnitude, workflow stage
- `WorkflowStepper` -- interactive button row showing all 12 workflow stages with color-coded states (green for complete, accent for current, muted for future), plus "advance to next" action
- `SessionList` -- fetches and displays observation sessions for a given target with formatted exposure times
- `Section` (local to TargetDetail/SessionForm) -- reusable card-like section with uppercase header
- `StatCard` (local to Dashboard) -- metric display card
- `FormField`/`FormSelect` (local to SessionForm) -- form input helpers

**Page components** (11 pages via HashRouter):
- `/dashboard` -- stat cards grid (4x2), catalogue progress bars, objects-by-type ranking, most-used equipment
- `/targets` -- paginated (48/page) grid with FTS search + object-type dropdown filter
- `/targets/:id` -- 3-column detail layout with workflow stepper, target properties, sessions, aliases, catalogue entries, external IDs
- `/sessions/new` and `/sessions/:id/edit` -- structured form with sections for When/Where, Conditions, Capture, Notes
- `/collections` -- card grid with progress bars
- `/collections/:id` -- progress header + target card grid
- `/equipment` -- equipment card grid with inline create form toggle
- `/observatory` -- observatory cards with create form and "set primary" action
- `/planning` -- observatory + date picker, then ranked list of tonight's targets with visibility metrics
- `/poster` -- dense grid visualization of collection completion (12-column grid, accent color for completed)
- `/settings` -- placeholder

**Data fetching pattern:** Pages use `useEffect` + `invoke()` to fetch data on mount/param change. State is managed with `useState`. No global state management (no Redux, Zustand, or Context). Each page manages its own loading/error states.

### 2. Electron + React Architecture

**Three-process model:**

**Main Process** (`src/main/index.ts`):
- Creates a `BrowserWindow` (1400x900, min 1024x700) with `contextIsolation: true` and `nodeIntegration: false`
- On `app.whenReady()`: calls `initDatabase()`, loads catalogue seed data, auto-generates catalogue collections, registers IPC handlers, then creates the window
- In dev mode loads from `ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL`; in production loads `../renderer/index.html`
- Standard macOS `activate` re-creation and `window-all-closed` quit logic

**Preload** (`src/preload/index.ts`):
- Minimal bridge: exposes a single `window.api.invoke(channel, ...args)` function via `contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld`
- This is the only communication pathway between renderer and main

**Renderer** (`src/renderer/`):
- React 18 SPA using `HashRouter` from react-router-dom v7
- Root render in `main.tsx` using `createRoot` with `StrictMode`
- All data access goes through `window.api.invoke()` via the `useIPC` hook or the `invoke` helper

**IPC Pattern:**
- The renderer calls `window.api.invoke(channel, args)` which maps to `ipcRenderer.invoke(channel, args)` in preload
- The main process registers handlers via `ipcMain.handle(channel, handler)` in `src/main/ipc/handlers.ts`
- Each channel has a corresponding Zod schema in `src/main/ipc/schemas.ts` that validates the incoming payload before it reaches business logic
- The `validated()` helper wraps every handler with `schema.parse(rawArgs)`, rejecting malformed data with Zod errors
- There are **30+ IPC channels** organized by domain: `targets:*`, `sessions:*`, `collections:*`, `workflow:*`, `equipment:*`, `folders:*`, `observatory:*`, `planning:*`, `dashboard:*`, `relationships:*`

---

### 3. Database Patterns

**Database Technology:**
- `better-sqlite3` for synchronous SQLite access
- `drizzle-orm` for schema definition and type safety (though services use raw SQL via `sqlite.prepare()` rather than the Drizzle query builder)
- Database stored at `app.getPath('userData')/astrorepo.db`
- WAL journal mode enabled for concurrent read performance
- Foreign keys enforced (`PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`)

**Schema (14 tables)** defined in `src/main/db/schema.ts`:

| Table | Purpose | Key Columns |
|---|---|---|
| `targets` | Central target registry | id (ULID PK), canonical_name (unique), object_type, ra_hours, dec_degrees, magnitude, angular_size_arcmin, constellation, workflow_stage, is_custom |
| `target_aliases` | Alternate names for targets | target_id (FK), alias (unique), source |
| `catalogues` | Catalogue definitions | name (unique), abbreviation (unique), total_objects, is_builtin |
| `catalogue_entries` | Target-to-catalogue mapping | catalogue_id (FK), target_id (FK), designation; unique on (catalogue_id, designation) and (catalogue_id, target_id) |
| `collections` | Target collections | name (unique), is_auto, source_catalogue_id (FK) |
| `collection_memberships` | Many-to-many collection-target | composite PK (collection_id, target_id) |
| `observation_sessions` | Observation log entries | date, observatory_id (FK), sky_quality, weather, seeing, transparency, moon_phase, exposure stats |
| `session_targets` | Session-to-target mapping | composite PK (session_id, target_id), is_primary |
| `equipment` | Equipment inventory | name, equipment_type, manufacturer, model, serial_number, is_active |
| `session_equipment` | Session-to-equipment mapping | composite PK (session_id, equipment_id), role |
| `observatories` | Observation locations | name (unique), latitude, longitude, altitude_m, timezone, is_primary |
| `workflow_stages` | Lifecycle stage definitions | name (unique), sort_order, is_default; 12 default stages seeded |
| `workflow_transitions` | Stage change audit log | target_id (FK), from_stage, to_stage, transitioned_at |
| `target_relationships` | Inter-target spatial/semantic links | source_target_id, related_target_id (both FK), relationship_type; unique constraint + self-reference CHECK |
| `folder_templates` | Directory structure templates | name, structure (JSON), is_builtin; Siril default seeded |
| `app_settings` | Key-value application config | key (PK), value |

**FTS5 Full-Text Search** (`src/main/db/fts.ts`):
- Virtual table `targets_fts` indexes `canonical_name`, `aliases` (group_concat of target_aliases), `description`, `constellation`
- Maintained via 5 triggers: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on targets, plus INSERT/DELETE on target_aliases
- `rebuildFtsIndex()` does a full reindex
- Search uses FTS5 MATCH with prefix matching (`"term"*`), falling back to LIKE on `canonical_name`/`alias` if FTS returns no results

**Indexes:** 12 indexes defined covering all major query patterns (alias lookup, canonical name, object type, workflow stage, designations, sessions by date, etc.)

**Migration approach:** Inline SQL in `runMigrations()` using `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` and `INSERT OR IGNORE` -- no formal migration versioning system

**ID generation:** All entities use ULIDs (`ulid` library) for sortable, unique identifiers

**Seed data:** Three JSON catalogue files (`messier.json` with 110 objects, `caldwell.json`, `sharpless.json`) loaded on first run with cross-catalogue identity resolution via alias matching

---

### 4. UI Component Patterns

**Styling:**
- **Tailwind CSS** with a custom dark-theme `astro` color palette defined in `tailwind.config.js`:
  - `astro-bg: #0f1729` (deep navy background)
  - `astro-surface: #1a2332` (card/surface background)
  - `astro-border: #2a3a4e` (borders)
  - `astro-accent: #4f9cf7` (interactive accent blue)
  - `astro-text: #e2e8f0` (primary text)
  - `astro-muted: #94a3b8` (secondary text)
  - `astro-success/warning/danger` for status colors
- Custom scrollbar styling via `::-webkit-scrollbar` in `global.css`
- No component library (Radix, shadcn/ui, etc.) -- all components are hand-built with Tailwind

**Layout architecture:**
- `Layout` -- flex container: `Sidebar` (fixed 224px width) + scrollable `main` area
- `PageContainer` -- page-level wrapper providing title, optional subtitle, optional action buttons, and max-width content area
- `Sidebar` -- 9 navigation items using `NavLink` with active state highlighting (accent color border + tinted background)

**Reusable components:**
- `SearchBar` -- debounced (300ms) text input with clear button
- `TargetCard` -- card component with object-type-specific color coding (11 type-to-color mappings), aliases display, constellation, magnitude, workflow stage
- `WorkflowStepper` -- interactive button row showing all 12 workflow stages with color-coded states (green for complete, accent for current, muted for future), plus "advance to next" action
- `SessionList` -- fetches and displays observation sessions for a given target with formatted exposure times
- `Section` (local to TargetDetail/SessionForm) -- reusable card-like section with uppercase header
- `StatCard` (local to Dashboard) -- metric display card
- `FormField`/`FormSelect` (local to SessionForm) -- form input helpers

**Page components** (11 pages via HashRouter):
- `/dashboard` -- stat cards grid (4x2), catalogue progress bars, objects-by-type ranking, most-used equipment
- `/targets` -- paginated (48/page) grid with FTS search + object-type dropdown filter
- `/targets/:id` -- 3-column detail layout with workflow stepper, target properties, sessions, aliases, catalogue entries, external IDs
- `/sessions/new` and `/sessions/:id/edit` -- structured form with sections for When/Where, Conditions, Capture, Notes
- `/collections` -- card grid with progress bars
- `/collections/:id` -- progress header + target card grid
- `/equipment` -- equipment card grid with inline create form toggle
- `/observatory` -- observatory cards with create form and "set primary" action
- `/planning` -- observatory + date picker, then ranked list of tonight's targets with visibility metrics
- `/poster` -- dense grid visualization of collection completion (12-column grid, accent color for completed)
- `/settings` -- placeholder

**Data fetching pattern:** Pages use `useEffect` + `invoke()` to fetch data on mount/param change. State is managed with `useState`. No global state management (no Redux, Zustand, or Context). Each page manages its own loading/error states.

- `tests/helpers/setup.ts` -- Provides `setupTestDb()` (in-memory SQLite), `teardownTestDb()`, `seedTarget()`, `seedObservatory()`, `seedEquipment()` helpers. Duplicates the migration SQL from `connection.ts` for isolated test databases.

- In-memory SQLite for full isolation (no file I/O)
- BDD-style EARS patterns (Given/When/Then)
- Coverage configured for `src/main/services/**` using V8 provider
